label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast Dec 19

Hi Rhonda, its Gary from the bus garage. Time to get the christmas breakfast on your books again if you'll have us. We're hoping for Saturday Dec 19, back room, 7am same as always. If the 19th is no good then the 12th would work.

Its a bigger bunch this year, 24 on the sign up sheet. That's 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, and Earl and his wife Carol. Will the back room hold 24 ok?

The reason its kind of a big one is Earl is retiring. He drove 31 years and his last day is the 18th, the day before. We want to do a little something for him at the breakfast but he don't know a thing about it and he can't find out. So please keep it quiet, and if you could tell the girls too in case he comes in between now and then. Carol knows, she's in on it.

Here's my question on that. Earl loves your cinnamon rolls and honestly they're better than any cake. Could you do a big tray of them with a candle in it? Or would it be ok if we brought a cake in from Sugarcreek? I'd pick the rolls myself but tell me which is easier on you and what a tray would run. Sugarcreek needs 5 days notice so I'd need to know ahead of that. Nothing fancy either way, he'd be embarrassed by a big fuss.

Couple other things.

Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip so he can't do the steps. Can he come in the side door, the one with no steps? Will it be unlocked at 7 or should he knock?

Patsy can't do eggs anymore. Could she get oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you got instead? And would hers be the same price or different?

On the food, same as last year would be good, the family style eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy, and everybody orders there own meat off the menu. $11 a head was fair. Is it still that? Fine if its up a little, just tell me so I can let everybody know before they show up.

Separate checks again if you can still do that.

And the coffee. I'm not complaining one bit, I know the urn quit on you last year and you felt bad about it. But with 24 of us would you be able to have a backup pot going just in case? This crowd drinks a lot of it, especially at 7 in the morning on a Saturday.

I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you want, so that'd be the 16th. Or the 9th if we end up on the 12th.

Thanks Rhonda, we appreciate you doing this every year.
Gary

reasons: It does not mention that the coffee ran out around 8:15 last year.
